summary: Sue Hamilton is a scholar in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. She completed her D.Phil at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson and Richard Gombrich, and held a post at King's College London (attested 2001–2003).
Suehiro Tanemura studied at the University of Tokyo (~1953–1957). He later held academic posts at Tokyo Metropolitan University (~1968–1973) and Kokugakuin University (~1973–1998).
Sujeet Kumar is a scholar in computational fields and Indology. He has held academic posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and B.P. Mandal College of Engineering.

Suk Fun Ng is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2014). She studied under teachers and doctoral supervisors Jing Yin, Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, and K. L. Dhammajoti.

Sukhlal Sanghvi was a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala and under Balakrishna Mishra, later serving at Gujarat Vidyapith, Banaras Hindu University as Chair of Jain Philosophy (1934–1944), and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan.

Sukra Sagar Shrestha was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He served as an epigraphist at the Archaeological Survey of India (attested 1986) and the Department of Archaeology (attested 1987).

Sukumar Sen was a scholar of linguistics and Indology who studied at the University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala. He served as Khaira Professor at Calcutta and Secretary of the Linguistic Society of India.

Sukumari Bhattacharji was an Indology scholar who earned a master's at the University of Calcutta and a doctorate at Jadavpur University. She served as professor of English at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and taught at Jadavpur University (1957–1986).
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indology scholar who studied under doctoral supervisor Pratap Bandyopadhyay. She holds an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa is a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies who studied at the University of Wales, Lampeter. He has held visiting positions at UC Berkeley, Harvard, Toronto, and Cornell, and founded the International Network of Engaged Buddhists.

Sumathi Ramaswamy is an Indologist and historian who studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania. She held faculty posts at the University of Pennsylvania (~1995–2000) and the University of Michigan (~2000–2007).

Sumi Lee is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA under Alexander L. Mayer at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a PhD under Robert E. Buswell Jr. at the University of California, Los Angeles.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre was a linguist and Indologist who earned his Ph.D at the University of London. He founded Deccan College, served as its Chair of Indo-European Philology (1942–1971), and later became Professor emeritus at the University of Texas at Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Chicago, studying under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi as well as Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is a scholar of linguistics and Indology. She studied under doctoral supervisor Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya and is attested as a research scholar/fellow at The Asiatic Society in 2026.

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied at Seoul National University and the University of Hamburg. He has held academic posts at the University of Vienna and Seoul National University.

Sung-Bae Park is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who completed his doctorate under Lewis Lancaster. He taught at Dongguk University (~1966–1972) and later served at Stony Brook University, beginning in 1977.

Sungdoo Ahn is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who earned his PhD at the University of Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen. He served as Director at Geumgang University and Professor at Seoul National University (attested 2013).

Sungtaek Cho is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He has held academic posts at Stony Brook University and Korea University, where he served as Director in 2003 and Professor (attested 2017).
Sunhee Kim completed a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under the supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).
